categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in real estate development, focusing on residential buildings, commercial office buildings, and townhouses for sale and lease. It also involves the trading and import/export of building materials. The business is concentrated on domestic sales within Taiwan, particularly in the Greater Taipei area.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced architectural planning and design, selecting top architectural teams and complying with relevant building regulations. It employs integrated construction management systems including budgeting, contracting, sales, and accounting systems linked with construction sites for real-time efficiency. The company also explores modular construction, smart construction technologies such as AI monitoring, drones, and automation to improve quality, cost control, and progress management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are middle-class homebuyers and investors in Taiwan, especially in the Taipei metropolitan area including Banqiao, Tucheng, Shulin, and Sanxia districts. The company targets self-use residential buyers and investors, with a focus on high-quality, well-located properties that meet market demand for residential and commercial real estate.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan, with a strong focus on the Greater Taipei area and other key urban centers such as New Taipei City, Taipei City, Hsinchu, and Taichung. All sales are domestic, with no export sales reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a real estate developer and project coordinator, positioned midstream in the supply chain. It acquires land, plans and designs projects, and outsources construction to subcontracted qualified construction firms, including its wholly owned construction subsidiary, to control quality and progress. It then sells finished properties to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include sustainable development with green and smart building technologies aligned with government net-zero carbon policies. The company invests in digital transformation such as BIM, AI monitoring, automation, and modular construction to enhance efficiency and reduce labor shortages. It also focuses on urban renewal projects, public housing, and integrating digital and IoT technologies for smart city solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale and lease of residential and commercial real estate properties. The company also earns income from land development and related real estate services. There is no indication of subscription or licensing revenue; income is mainly from property sales and leasing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the Taiwanese real estate market, particularly in the Greater Taipei area. It holds a solid market position with a market share of approximately 3.5% to 5.5% in Taipei and New Taipei City in recent years. Its competitive advantages include strong local market knowledge, quality construction, financial stability, and professional management, placing it above average in competitiveness compared to peers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$12.39 billion, a 161% increase from the previous year, with net profit around NT$2.97 billion. The company has a stable financial structure with total assets exceeding NT$55 billion and equity of about NT$13.7 billion. It shows strong growth momentum supported by increased project completions and sales.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes integrity, quality, and professional service, focusing on building safe, environmentally friendly, and comfortable living spaces. It differentiates through superior architectural design, strict quality and cost control, and excellent after-sales service including community management support. Its commitment to sustainable and smart building technologies further enhances its competitive edge.
